notes:
Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch) sufficed - SFCC/Demandware SSR site, no client-render gap, no bot wall. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only standard SFCC controller/param blocks) and lists Sitemap: https://www.tanagra.me/sitemap_index.xml. Fetched sitemap_index.xml -> sitemap_4-category.xml (full category taxonomy, EN+AR) and grepped for Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving/New Year/Eid/Ramadan/festive/noel/santa/sapin keywords; also checked sitemap_5-content.xml (editorial/blog) for the same terms (none found there, confirming no PLP hides under a content-only URL) and the homepage/404 mega-menu link list (seasonal hubs are promo-driven, not in the static main nav, but all resolve as real PLPs). For each candidate URL, fetched SSR HTML and read the true site-reported product count from the grid-footer element `data-total-product-count` (e.g. `

`), confirmed via breadcrumb trail and tag which holiday the site itself attributes the page to. Counts vary meaningfully page-to-page (3 to 1248), ruling out a static/bugged placeholder value. CHRISTMAS: URL path uses 'festive' but the site's own <title> tags explicitly say 'Festive & Christmas Décor/Dining/Gifts', pinning the ambiguous 'Festive' label to Christmas specifically (no separate generic-festive vs Christmas split needed). /en/festive itself 301-redirects (no parent PLP exists) so the 3 children are listed directly, no grouping row. Also found /en/collections/baccarat-noel, a distinct designer PLP (breadcrumb 'Baccarat Noel', 3 SKUs) for Baccarat's Christmas ornament/collectible line - genuinely Christmas per its own name (Noel) despite living under the generic /collections/ path used by ~300 non-seasonal designer lines (checked full sitemap for other -noel/christmas/xmas/santa collection slugs - none else found). Kept as a separate row since it's a distinct taxonomy branch from festive/*, per the overlap-is-allowed rule. EID: single leaf page /en/eid-gifting (breadcrumb: Home > Eid Gifting, no parent Eid node, no other eid-* URLs in the sitemap). RAMADAN: /en/ramadan IS a real parent PLP (200, data-total-product-count=1101) with 5 sibling children also in the sitemap (ramadan-home-decor, ramadan-dining, ramadan-scents, ramadan-gifting, ramadan-exclusives), so kept as a grouping row (is_group true, qty/link null) with the 5 children listed individually - avoids double-counting per the parent+children rule. Children's counts sum higher than the parent (expected overlap across dining/decor/gifting facets, not summed/inferred). DIWALI: single leaf page /en/diwali (breadcrumb: Home > Diwali, title 'Diwali Decor | Luxury Diwali Gifts'), no sibling sub-pages found. UAE has a large Indian expat market so a dedicated Diwali gifting hub at a luxury gift retailer is plausible; not a sitewide sale/clearance page (no discount/clearance framing, distinct curated count of 922 vs a ~6,400-URL total product sitemap). VALENTINE'S DAY: /en/valentine itself 307-redirects (no parent PLP), so its 3 real children are listed directly: For Her (qty 69), For Him (qty 39), Dinner Date/Table Setting (qty 102) - each breadcrumbs to Home > Valentine > X, confirming site-taxonomy membership even though 'For Her'/'For Him' titles don't say Valentine by themselves. Verified these are NOT duplicates of the generic non-seasonal /en/gifts-for-her (541 products) and /en/gifts-for-him nav categories - different URL, different (much smaller, curated) count, so genuinely a separate Valentine-specific listing. A 4th sitemap URL, /en/valentine/tray/ashtrays ('Discover Luxury Ashtrays'), returned a genuine 'No results' empty-grid page (0 product tiles, 0 data-pid) - excluded as a dead/empty sitemap entry, not a valid row (legit-zero). CHECKED AND EXCLUDED (not genuine holiday PLPs): /en/gift-guide (title 'Discover Luxury Gifts', a general gift landing/editorial hub, 1627 products - not tied to any specific holiday); /en/luxury-giveaways, /en/gift-sets, /en/gifts-for-home, /en/wedding-gifts (generic gifting categories, no holiday association in title/breadcrumb). NO EVIDENCE FOUND for Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, or New Year anywhere in the category or content sitemaps, or in nav link scan - none of these terms appear on any PLP or content URL. Given this is a France-heritage luxury tableware/homeware retailer (Baccarat, Lalique, Bernardaud, L'Objet, Daum, Christofle-style brands) operating in the UAE, absence of Halloween/Thanksgiving is expected and Easter's absence was cross-checked (no easter/paques/pascua terms anywhere). Arabic-language mirrors of every included URL exist (ar/eid-gifting, ar/ramadan/*, ar/valentine/*, ar/diwali is EN-only, ar/festive/* ) and resolve to the same underlying category id/count - kept the English row per company, per the single-canonical-row rule; not double-counted.
